name: cj-ts-code-review
description: DSH plugin code_review: review code against docs/IMPORTANCE.md (user-owned rules), with rule ids and P0..P3 importance resolved locally, verbatim-snippet validation, and a report ordered by importance. Zero dependencies, Node built-ins only.

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check src/config.mjs && node --check src/llm.mjs && node --check src/rules.mjs && node --check src/files.mjs && node --check src/prompt.mjs && node --check src/parse.mjs && node --check src/report.mjs && node --check src/tools/review.mjs
